instruction: From now on, please always put my toy blocks in the purple toy box, my mugs on the cyan tray and my books on the orange tray. Tidy the desk that way now.

attempts.code:
go_home()
obs = observe()
book = obs["objects"]["red_book"]
tray = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]
book_z = book["top_z"]
tray_center = tray["center"]
tray_half_size = tray["half_size"]

# Move above the book
move_to(book["center"][0], book["center"][1], book_z + 0.1)
# Descend to grasp height
move_to(book["center"][0], book["center"][1], book_z - 0.01)
# Open gripper and approach
open_gripper()
# Close gripper and check
close_gripper()
if not obs["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grip red_book")

# Lift above the table
move_to(book["center"][0], book["center"][1], book_z + 0.1)

# Move above the tray
move_to(tray_center[0], tray_center[1], tray_center[2] + 0.1)
# Descend to place height
move_to(tray_center[0], tray_center[1], tray_center[2] + 0.01)
# Release
open_gripper()
# Lift
move_to(tray_center[0], tray_center[1], tray_center[2] + 0.1)

attempts.lesson: Adjust the grasp height to be 0.01 m below the book's top_z (i.e., use grasp_height = book_z - 0.01) and align the gripper yaw with the book's long_axis_yaw (0.463) to ensure proper grip and stable placement.
